projects.name: Nigah AI
projects.description: Nigah is Urdu for vision. It turns a phone camera into a voice guide for blind and low vision users in Pakistan: point it at a medicine box or a banknote and it speaks the answer back in natural Urdu.
projects.featuredTagline: An accessibility assistant that turns a phone camera into a voice guide, in Urdu, for blind and low vision users across Pakistan.
projects.featuredDescription: Nigah identifies medicines, reads expiry dates, and recognizes every Pakistani rupee note, then speaks the result back in natural Urdu voice. A two step medicine scan, a hardened name parser with 35 passing unit tests, and a strict two outcome contract mean a user only ever hears a real result or an honest "couldn't identify it" — never a guess.
projects.short: An Urdu-voice accessibility assistant that turns a phone camera into a guide for blind and low vision users across Pakistan.

skillGroups.label: Reliability contract
items: Only two outcomes: real result, or honest failure
Bare strengths like "500mg" rejected as names

projects.name: IntelliCharge
projects.description: A predictive electricity billing system split across two languages: a C++ engine handles tariff logic through inheritance and polymorphism, while Java drives the console workflow and runs that engine as a process, passing data back and forth through files.
projects.featuredTagline: A predictive electricity billing system that models tariffs and forecasts next month's usage.
projects.featuredDescription: A predictive electricity billing system split across two languages: a C++ engine handles tariff logic through inheritance and polymorphism, while Java drives the console workflow and runs that engine as a process, passing data back and forth through files.
projects.short: A predictive electricity billing system in C++ and Java, with tariff modeling for domestic, commercial and industrial customers and next month usage prediction.
